en-US.name: Steady Noise Premium
en-US.summary: Adds pink and brown noise, rain, ocean waves, and a fan.
en-US.description: Adds pink and brown noise, rain, ocean waves, and a fan to Steady Noise. Every sound plays all night or on a timer, with no ads. Monthly plan with a free week.

customProductPrompts.purchasePromptDescription: Steady Noise Premium adds pink and brown noise, rain, ocean waves, and a fan.
customProductPrompts.boughtCardDescription: You now have Steady Noise Premium: white, pink, and brown noise, rain, ocean waves, and a fan.

inSkillProductDefinition.testingInstructions: Ask for pink noise, brown noise, rain, ocean waves, or a fan, or say 'buy premium'. Premium unlocks those five sounds. White noise is free with no time limit. The yearly plan (premium_annual) unlocks the same sounds.
